findings.current: This is no time to act like a child.
findings.defect: The draft reframes Taekyung’s self-mockery as a judgment about timing. He is deriding himself for behaving like a child, not saying that the present moment is unsuitable for childish behavior.
findings.rationale: 어린애도 아니고 is a self-directed rhetorical rebuke meaning that he is not a child.

findings.current: When had I ever lived while looking down at the road ahead?
findings.defect: The literal spatial wording is unnatural and obscures the intended meaning of anticipating or planning for the future.
findings.rationale: 앞날을 내다보다 means to look ahead to or anticipate the future, not physically look down at a road.
findings.replacement: When had I ever lived with an eye toward the future?

findings.current: Striking out with the bases loaded in a comeback opportunity did not make the earth collapse.
findings.defect: The draft omits 삼 구, the specific detail that the batter strikes out on three pitches.
findings.rationale: 삼 구 삼진 explicitly describes a three-pitch strikeout, and the quantity is part of the exaggerated sports comparison.
findings.replacement: Striking out on three pitches with the bases loaded and a chance to come from behind did not make the earth collapse.
findings.source: 역전 만루 찬스에서 삼 구 삼진을 당한다고 해서 땅이 꺼지지는 않는다.

findings.current: It was also the last will of an A-rank Hunter who had been hugely popular a few years ago before dying in a Gate.
findings.defect: “Last will” denotes a testament or instructions concerning one’s estate, whereas the source identifies the quoted remark as the Hunter’s final words.
findings.rationale: 마지막 유언 here refers to what the Hunter said immediately before death, while 한창 인기를 끌다가 places his death at the height of his popularity.
findings.replacement: Those were also the last words of an A-rank Hunter who died in a Gate at the height of his popularity a few years ago.
findings.source: 몇 년 전 한창 인기를 끌다가 게이트에서 죽은 어느 A급 헌터의 마지막 유언이기도 했다.

findings.current: so I calmly welcomed the unwelcome guest.
findings.defect: The draft omits 애써, making Taekyung sound genuinely calm instead of showing that he has to make an effort to maintain his composure.
findings.rationale: 애써 marks deliberate effort and preserves the contrast between his outward reception and inner agitation.
findings.replacement: so I did my best to remain calm as I welcomed the unwelcome guest.
findings.source: 다행히 그보다 한발 앞서 모든 대비를 끝마친 나는 애써 침착하게 불청객을 맞이했다.

findings.defect: The impersonal “unfortunately” removes Team Leader Choi’s explicit apology, weakening his restrained, deferential register before he admits that he independently verified Taekyung’s claim.
findings.rationale: 죄송스럽게도 directly expresses personal apology rather than merely describing the situation as unfortunate.

summary: Six actionable findings: two altered introspective beats, one omitted quantity, one mistranslated deathbed term, and two lost pragmatic or register cues.
